_comment: The eight checkpoints behind every published number. One row of the results
table traces to exactly one entry here.
SELECTION RULE, applied uniformly to every arm: among the checkpoints saved on
even epochs, take the one with the best SYNTHETIC validation rotation error. No
real-domain measurement informs the choice - lightbox and sunlamp are touched
once, at evaluation, and never for selection.
